sentences.text: The Bail Application under Section 439 of CrPC has been filed on behalf of the petitioner seeking regular bail.
2. An FIR bearing No. 41/2022 under Sections 409/420/467/468/471/120B of the IPC has been registered at Police Station EOW, on the complaint of the mother against her daughter.
The parties have arrived at a settlement dated 12.06.2024 vide which the accused has agreed to refund Rs.2 Crore, to the respondent No. 2/mother.
The detailed have been reduced into writing in the Settlement Agreement.
The respondent No. 2 endorses the settlement and submits that in view of this settlement, she has no objection if the Regular Bail is granted to the accsued.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 13/07/2024 at 05:10:21 3.
It is also submitted on behalf of the accused/applicant that she has a 20 year disabled child, who is now in the custody of the mother, who is taking care of the child.
The accused was taken in judicial custody on 13.05.2024, after which she was admitted to interim bail for one month.
Presently, she is in judicial custody.

sentences.text: 4. Submissions heard.

5. Considering the submissions made and also that the applicant has undertaken to return Rs.2 Crores to her mother/respondent No. 2 and that they have arrived at a settlement, the petitioner is admitted to bail, on the following terms and conditions:-
a) The petitioner/accused shall furnish a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- and one surety of the like amount, subject to the satisfaction of the learned Trial Court.
b) The petitioner/accused shall appear before the Court as and when the matter is taken up for hearing.
c) The petitioner/accused shall provide mobile number to the IO concerned which shall be kept in working condition at all times and he shall not change the mobile number, without prior intimate to the Investigating Officer concerned.
d) The petitioner/accused shall not indulge in any criminal activity and shall not communicate with or come in contact with the witnesses.
e) The petitioner/accused shall not leave the country, without permission of this Court.
f) The petitioner/accused shall not change his residential This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 13/07/2024 at 05:10:21 address and in case of change of the residential address, the same shall be intimated to this Court,
by way of affidavit.
6. The application stands disposed of.
7. A copy of this order be sent to the Jail Superintendent forthwith.
NEENA BANSAL KRISHNA, J JULY 12, 2024/RS
